reviews.title: The best PC case there is.
reviews.comment: I have been building PC's since the XT was new. This is the best case I have ever built a PC in. I have two minor complaints. 1. Weight, this is heavy at 33 pounds empty. More aluminum please! 2. 4 Top of case USB 3.1 ports has two mother board header connectors. Every mother board in the world only has 1 USB header plug which means you have too get a splitter for all 4 top of case USB 3.1 ports to work. This splitter should have been included. If you get the splitter available on Amazon, be advised it is too short, so get the extension cable too. Corsair did an excellent job wiring the iCUE fans, controller with the ARGB strips. Just daisy chain plug in your additional iCUE fans and devices using the iCUE USB cables. I have all 10 fans in mine. Keeps all components very cool. A minor issue with iCUE is it auto dims profiles because they want a maximum of 7 fans. Some profiles look drastically different than they would in a case with fewer fans because of this auto dimming. I hope they fix this issue. An iCUE Link Titan 360 RX LCD Liquid CPU Cooler keeps my Ryzen 7 9800X3d around 34c idle. I have never seen my CPU above 40c. I left the LX fans in the case front. I used Corsair QX fans on the cooler and side, rear fans so I have even more LED lights! Just beautiful. AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU, TUFF Gaming X870 WiFi plus mother board with 64GB RAM, XFX Mercury AMD Radeon RX 9070XT OC Gaming Edition with RGB 16GB GDDR6 powered by Corsair HX1000I power supply.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.comment: Love it and very easy to open and add your parts. Build quality is good didn't notice anything that stuck out or was concerned me. Lights on the top and bottom were bright and all the fan I put in it fit well.
reviews.author: Kay

reviews.title: My favorite PC Case
reviews.comment: My favorite case, this thing is crazy epic. Plenty of room especially for a 5090, keep in mind though with a 5090 it won't fit a asus rog herculx gpu support bracket. The internal Link set up for this is great for my icue set up, overall design is great, built in lighting is awesome. Its really easy to work with regarding cable management, and can handle a beefy 1500w corsair psu easily, but you will have to remove the additional HDD bay which I don't use so I didn't really care, if you are using HDD's you should probably have a NAS anyways especially with how much heat your pc will generate. This is by far my favorite case.
reviews.author: Themetacognologist

reviews.comment: Definitely have plenty of room in it, its super bright once you get past the issues which aren't to hard to figure out. Cable management is fantastic, and easy to assemble

reviews.title: RGB strips brightness reduced to 20% automatically! Do not buy for the RGB!
reviews.comment: The built in strips have brightness reduced all the way down to 20% and you cannot get around it. Corsair is selling the case with this "defect". Search and find multiple Reddit threads about people working with Corsair support on this. No solution! DO NOT BUY THIS CASE if you are buying for the RGB.
